cues: A ten kilogram block is pulled across a rough floor with forty newtons.
Friction opposes the motion: the coefficient of friction times the normal reaction, a quarter of a hundred, twenty five newtons.
The net force is fifteen newtons, so the acceleration is one and a half metres per second squared.
